verdict.rationale: ImageMagick is a self-hosted C library with official bindings for C, C++, Python, .NET and Node.js, plus a CLI that builds from source and runs on Linux, Windows and macOS. Its docs cover tailoring security policies for your own server environment. Community reports confirm it is mostly shipped inside other apps and run on user-operated infrastructure such as a Windows SaaS and Heroku, so the engine runs entirely within the developer's own stack. Missing for 10: no evidence of an official container image or packaged server mode.
